notes: I replaced the per-word capitalization with whole-string `str.capitalize()` (first character uppercased, rest lowercased), which matches E1 and nearly all of E2 — including the leading-space and punctuation cases that broke the per-word model. The single oddity "multi   space"→"Ulti   space" doesn't fit any clean rule, so I treat it as an anomaly rather than special-casing it.
